targets.query:
from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "infrastructure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.url == "192.168.1.2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "result_code")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "infrastructure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.url == "192.168.2.1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "result_code")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "wan_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.url == "8.8.8.8")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "result_code")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_load1")
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 2.0 * 100.0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Average"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement", "device", "host", "location", "url"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_load1")
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 2.0 * 100.0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Peak"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement", "device", "host", "location", "url"])

total_mem = from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_memory_MemTotal_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(column: "_value", fn: (key) => true)

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes")
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (total_mem[0] - r._value) / total_mem[0] * 100.0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Average"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement", "device", "host", "location", "url"])

total_mem = from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_memory_MemTotal_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(column: "_value", fn: (key) => true)

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes")
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (total_mem[0] - r._value) / total_mem[0] * 100.0}))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Peak"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement", "device", "host", "location", "url"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_network_receive_bytes_total" and (r.device == "eth0" or r.device == "eth1"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> mean()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Download Avg"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_network_receive_bytes_total" and (r.device == "eth0" or r.device == "eth1"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> max()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Download Peak"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_network_transmit_bytes_total" and (r.device == "eth0" or r.device == "eth1"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> mean()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Upload Avg"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_network_transmit_bytes_total" and (r.device == "eth0" or r.device == "eth1"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> max()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Upload Peak"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "router_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "node_network_receive_errs_total" or r._field == "node_network_receive_drop_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "eth0" or r.device == "eth1")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "node_network_receive_errs_total" then "Errors" else "Dropped"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "utilization_percent")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device", "pool_name", "collector", "host"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active_leases")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Active"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device", "pool_name", "collector", "host"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available_leases")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Available"}))

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "static_leases")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "Static"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device", "pool_name", "collector", "host"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dynamic_leases")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_pool" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lease_rate_per_hour")
  |> mean()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Leases/Hour"})
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_field", "_measurement", "device", "pool_name", "collector", "host"])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dhcp_lease" and r.device == "glmt2500a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "remaining_seconds")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_measurement", "_field", "device", "collector", "host"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "remaining_seconds"})
  |> sort(columns: ["remaining_seconds"], desc: false)

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "infrastructure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.url == "192.168.1.2" or r.url == "192.168.2.1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "average_response_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r.url == "192.168.1.2" then "GLMT2500A" else "Starlink"}))

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "wan_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "average_response_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r.url == "8.8.8.8" then "Google (8.8.8.8)" else "Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)"}))

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "infrastructure" or r.type == "wan_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "percent_packet_loss")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r.url == "192.168.1.2" then "GLMT" else if r.url == "192.168.2.1" then "Starlink" else if r.url == "8.8.8.8" then "Google" else if r.url == "192.168.100.1" then "Starlink Dishy" else if r.url == "1.1.1.1" then "Cloudflare" else "Unknown"}))

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "infrastructure" or r.type == "wan_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "standard_deviation_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r.url == "192.168.1.2" then "GLMT" else if r.url == "192.168.2.1" then "Starlink" else if r.url == "8.8.8.8" then "Google" else if r.url == "192.168.100.1" then "Starlink Dishy" else if r.url == "1.1.1.1" then "Cloudflare" else "Unknown"}))

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r.type == "starlink_dishy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "result_code")

from(bucket: "network")

from(bucket: "network")

from(bucket: "network")

from(bucket: "network")

from(bucket: "network")
